करमर्द(क)
(1) CARISSA CARANDAS LINN. [Intern. Code] (Avk; Bpn, p. 565; Dutt;
DWH 2, p. 419-420; Dy, p. 507-508; Gul; HK; IRM 2, p. 82; Kav;
KB 2, p. 1546-1548; MW; Nadk. 1, nr. 449 and 477; PW; V 2, p.
83) = C. CONGESTA WIGHT (Dutt; HK; Kav); [Flora Pavagadh, p.
136: C. CONGESTA WIGHT = C. CARANDAS GRAHAM (प्रो पर्ते) (NON
LINN.) = C. CARANDAS VAR. CONGESTA BEDD.]; see also Hooker 3, p.
630-631;
(2) C. DIFFUSA (Avk; Nadk. 1, nr. 450); the Index Kewensis men-
tions only C. DIFFUSA RIDLEY, a species from the Malayan peninsula,
but Hooker describes vol. 3, p. 631 a species from India: C. SPINARUM
DC. = C. DIFFUSA ROXB.; see Roxb., p. 231-232: C. DIFFUSA ROXB.,
करमदिका;
(3) CAPPARIS CARANDAS BURM. F. (Avk; Nadk. 1, nr. 449 and 477);
(4) FLACOURTIA CATAPHRACTA ROXB. EX WILLD. (Vśs: = पानीया-
मलक) [= F. JANGOMAS (LOUR.) RAEUSCH.] [Chopra] = F. JANGOMAS
RAEUSCH. = F. JANGOMAS STEUD. = STIGMAROTA JANGOMAS LOUR.

कर्कन्धू̆
(1) ZIZYPHUS JUJUBA LAM. (Bpn, p. 563-564; HB; HK: the variety
with small fruits; MW; PW: the variety with a large type of fruit,
fructu oblongo acc. to Voigt; Vśs) = Z. SORORIA ROEM. ET SCHULT.
(Nadk. 1, nr. 2667);
(2) Z. OENOPLIA MILL. (Kav; KB 1, p. 595-596; V 8, p. 8) = Z.
[]
NAPECA ROXB. (Roxb., p. 206) = RHAMNUS OENOPLIA LINN. (KB 1,
p. 595);
(3) Z. ROTUNDIFOLIA LAM. = Z. NUMMULARIA WIGHT ET ARN. (Dgv,
nr. 84; Gul); Cakra remarks on Ca.Sū. 25, 49 and Ca.Si. 3, 8 that
कर्कन्धु designates the very small शृगालबदरी; शृगालबदरी:
a) = 1), acc. to KB 1, p. 589-591.
b) = 2), acc. to KB 1, p. 595-596 and Roxb., p. 206.

(1) GOSSYPIUM HERBACEUM LINN. (Ainslie 2, p. 282-284; Avk; Bpn,
p. 374; Chopra; Dgv, nr. 45; Dutt; Dy, p. 109-112; Gul; KB 1, p.
344-346; Na 1, nr. 55; Nadk. 1, nr. 1145; Roxb., p. 520; Sanyal; V 2,
p. 43; Vśs; Watt CP, p. 575-576) = G. HIRSUTUM LINN. (Vśs; Wise) =
G. INDICUM LAM. (Nadk. 1, nr. 1147) = G. RELIGIOSUM LINN. (Avk);
(2) G. ARBOREUM LINN. (Avk);
(3) [G. STOCKSII MAST. VAR. HERBACEUM LINN.] (Avk; DWH 1, p.
224-228); see Hooker 1, p. 346-347.

karamardī
Su. Sū. 38, 73 (omitted in Bt.), Ḍa.: karamardī kṣīraphalā ‘karamadī’
iti loke. Śiva. Dr., phalavarga 11 (karamarda): karamardaṃ kaṇṭakīpha-
lam iti candrikā, tad dvividhaṃ mahad alpaṃ ca. tatra mahat prāyaśo
grāmabhavam amlaṃ ca. alpā tu karamardī vanajā madhurāmlaphalā iti ca
vyācaṣṭe. See also Bt. on karamarda: karamarda is known as Carissa
carandas Linn. and its wild kind called karamardikā is Carissa spina-
rum Linn.

karavīra
(1) Nerium indicum Miller = N. odorum Solander (HK; Bpn, guḍūcyādi-
varga 82-84; Nadk. 1, nr. 1709; Na 1, nr. 326; KB 2, p. 1584-1586) (śvetapuṣpa
karavīra);
(2) Thevetia peruviana (Pers.) K. Schum. = T. neriifolia Juss. (Bpn,
guḍūcyādivarga 82-84; KB 2, p. 1554-1556) (raktapuṣpa karavīra) (this
species is a native of tropical America, now pantropic).

kāravella
(1) Momordica charantia Linn. (Dgv, nr. 168; Na 1, nr. 231; Nadk. 1,
nr. 1639; V. 2, p. 81; Bpn, śākavarga 63; Bt.; DEP 5, p. 256; Dutt; KB 2,
p. 1130-1132);
(2) M. cochinchinensis (Lour.) Spreng. (HK; Nadk. 1, nr. 1639).
